testimonials.text: An amazing course with the true potential of granting confidence in recognizing when to perform sternotomy, thoracotomy, pulmonary tractotomy and other related cardiothoracic surgical interventions in cardiac trauma. Awesome indeed. Regards!
I liked it that it is scenario based and it is progressive with time, just like as it happens in real life.
This course provided an excellent foundation in trauma decision-making and surgical priorities. The clinical scenarios were realistic and thought-provoking.
The course provided an exceptional, highly structured review of cardiac trauma management that significantly enhances practical readiness for complex clinical scenarios.
